resources.string: Capsule is an application to help you run other applications in an isolated profile. It does so by making use of the Work Profile feature of Android. Click "Next", and we will provide you with more information about Capsule, and guide you through the setup process. We suggest that you read through all of the following pages carefully.

By default, Capsule will not ask for any individual permissions. However, once you proceed with the setup process, Capsule will try to set up a Work Profile and hence become the profile manager of said profile. This will grant Capsule an extensive list of permissions inside the profile, comparable to that of a Device Admin, albeit confined to the profile. Being the profile manager is necessary for most of Capsule's functionality. Some advanced features of Capsule may require more permissions outside the Work Profile. When needed, Capsule will ask for those permissions separately when you enable the corresponding features.

Capsule is developed and tested on AOSP-like Android derivatives. This includes AOSP (Android Open Source Project), Google Android (on Pixels), and most AOSP-based open-source custom ROMs such as LineageOS. If your phone is running one of the Android derivatives listed above, then congratulations! Capsule is probably going to work correctly on your device. Some device vendors introduce very invasive customizations into the Android code base, resulting in conflicts, incompatibility and unexpected behavior. Some custom ROMs can also introduce compatibility-breaking changes, but generally these are rarer occurrences compared to phone vendor-introduced incompatibilities. Capsule is merely an interface into the Work Profile feature provided by the system. If the feature provided by the system is broken or non-standard, Capsule could not magically resolve the issue on its own. If you are currently using a vendor-modified Android version that is known to break Work Profiles, you have been warned. You may proceed anyway, but there is no guarantee that Capsule would behave correctly under these circumstances.

We are now ready to set up Capsule for you. If your device is running Android 7 or lower, please first ensure that your device is not in Do Not Disturb mode, because you will need to click on a notification later to finalize the setup process.\n\nWhen you are ready, click on \"Next\" to begin the setup process.
We are trying to initialize Work Profile and set up Capsule on your device.

We were unable to set up Capsule.

If this device already has a work profile from Capsule or another management app, remove it before trying again: open Settings → Accounts and backup, switch to the Work tab, tap Manage accounts and remove the work profile. On custom ROMs, setup can also fail when the system provisioning role holder or related setup components are missing.

Use "Open settings" below to reach the accounts screen where a leftover work profile can be removed. Tap Copy details to collect device and provisioning-handler information for a bug report.
A work profile already exists on this device. Android allows only one, so remove it before setting up Capsule.
A work profile exists, but Capsule is not installed inside it. It is probably managed by another app; remove it before setting up Capsule.
This device does not allow creating a work profile right now. A device owner or another policy may be in effect.
Provisioning was cancelled before it completed. If you cancelled it yourself, start again whenever you are ready.

You should now be seeing a notification from Capsule. Please click on that notification to finish the setup process. If you do not see the notification, make sure your device is not in Do Not Disturb mode and try pulling down the notification center. To reset Capsule and start over, you can clear the data of Capsule in Settings.
Click here to finish setting up Capsule
Congratulations! You are one click away from finishing setting up Capsule.
Apps on the Auto Freeze list will be frozen the next time the screen is locked.
The system package installer is working. This dialog closes automatically.
Already installed in the other profile
Application "%s" was removed from the work profile and can be cloned back later.
Application installation finished in work profile.

Manipulating apps that are hidden from the list could cause crashes and all sorts of unexpected behavior. However, this feature can be useful when faulty vendor-customized ROMs does not enable all necessary system apps in work profile by default. If you continue, you are on your own.

Adds a Capsule root with the other profile\'s files to the system Files app and document pickers. This root is independent from the system picker directions below; keep this switch off to fully block cross-profile file access.
Main profile may pick work profile files
Allow apps in the main profile to pick files from the work profile through Android\'s system pickers. Android itself always lets work profile apps pick main profile files; no app can turn that off.
Deny access from main profile to contacts inside work profile.

Enable a fake NFC payment service in the main profile, so that the \"contactless payments\" option under Settings - NFC becomes enabled to allow you to choose a payment app inside the work profile. This works around an Android bug that makes it impossible to select a payment app inside the work profile if none is available in the main profile.
When the screen is locked, automatically freeze every unfrozen app on the Auto Freeze list, including apps launched through \"Unfreeze & Launch\".
Enter a number of minutes between 0 and 1440

Do NOT freeze foreground apps (with visible activity) when you lock your screen. This can be useful for apps like music players, but you\'ll need to manually freeze them through \"Batch Freeze Shortcut\" afterwards.
This app does not publish editable managed restrictions.
This restriction uses a nested format that Capsule cannot edit yet.
Could not save these app restrictions.
Could not load managed restrictions for this app.
Capsule setup complete. Now restarting Capsule. If Capsule didn\'t start automatically, you may launch it again from your launcher.
Work profile not found. Please restart the app to re-provision the profile.
The profile stays isolated and nothing runs inside it until it is resumed.
A work profile exists, but Capsule cannot reach it. It may be managed by another app, or Capsule was removed from it. The profile can be removed under Settings → Accounts and backup → Work.
A work profile has not been set up yet. Start the setup to create one.
Application \"%s\" is already installed in the other profile.
Cannot clone system apps to a profile that Capsule has no control of.
This system app could not be enabled in the other profile.
Cannot uninstall system apps in a profile that Capsule has no control of.
The app operation was cancelled or could not be started. Please try again.
Cannot add shortcuts to your launcher. Please contact the developer for more information.
All apps in \"Auto Freeze\" list have been frozen successfully.
Cannot launch app %s because it has no GUI.
Capsule needs Usage Stats permission to do this. Please enable the permission for the Capsule app shown after you press \"Ok\".
Capsule also needs Usage Stats permission in the work profile. Please enable the permission for the Capsule app shown after you press \"Ok\".
Capsule needs access to All Files for File Shuttle. Please enable the permission for the Capsule app shown after you press \"Ok\".
Capsule also needs access to All Files in the work profile. Please enable the permission for the Capsule app shown after you press \"Ok\".

Capsule needs to Draw over Other Apps in order for File Shuttle to function correctly. Please enable the permission for the Capsule app shown after you press \"Ok\". This permission is used to start File Shuttle services in the background.
Capsule also needs to Draw over Other Apps in the work profile. Please enable the permission for the Capsule app shown after you press \"Ok\".
Cloning non-system apps to another profile is currently not possible on MIUI. Please clone your system\'s app store (e.g. Play Store) into the other profile and then install apps from there.
Adds a certificate file to the work profile trust store. PEM and DER formats are supported.
Certificate installed in the work profile.
The certificate could not be installed. Check that the file contains a valid certificate.
The certificate could not be removed.
Apps in the work profile will stop trusting this certificate. The certificate can be installed again afterwards if needed.
